text:
anya-gtm: partner requested one marketplace offer that covers Snowflake + Databricks + Qdrant/Milvus. they want procurement by SKU but we want single commercial SKU. thoughts?
mike-partners: single SKU + manifest metadata seems best. keeps contracting simple. partner ops can map metadata to HW SKUs.
sylvia-eng: agree. eng will publish install_commands and a small smoke_test_commands block for cert lab. note: databricks unity-catalog role mapping not in mainline yet. we can provide a quick shim for certification.
raj-arch: i'll produce hw_profile mapping (dev/standard/htp) -> partner HW SKU and expected qps. dev:1xA10g, standard:1xA40, htp:2xA100.
natalie-legal: legal ok with single SKU if manifest includes residency flag and cert_data_policy: "synthetic_only; pii_redaction". we'll require NDA before raw logs are shared.
ops-bot: cert-scheduler: available 2024-04-16 09:00 UTC (2h) and 2024-04-18 13:00 UTC (2h). reply with slot to reserve.
anya-gtm: reserve 4/16 09:00. sylvia, can you deliver happy-path CLI+SQL (unattended) within 48h?
sylvia-eng: yes. deliverable: install CLI, databricks shim steps, and two SQL snippets for snowflake smoke. will include in manifest keys: "install_commands","smoke_test_commands","hw_profile","residency","vector_backends","fulfillment_hook".
mike-partners: ops-bot, make sure marketplace accepts fulfillment_hook for license callbacks.
ops-bot: marketplace supports webhook in manifest via "fulfillment_hook".
anya-gtm: action items: anya -> draft manifest + single SKU page; sylvia -> shim + install/smoke commands; raj -> hw mapping doc; natalie -> residency + cert clause. target: submit manifest to partner catalog week of May 6.
mike-partners: thanks team. ping here if blockers. :thumbsup:
